map.📖 查看「投诉分类分析 使用指南」: 📖 View the Complaint Classification Analysis user guide
map.投诉分类：按关键词库将每行投诉匹配到类别（质量、物流、服务、退换）；类别占比 =: Complaint classification: each line of complaint text is matched to a category by the keyword library of quality, logistics, service and returns; the category share = the number of items in that category ÷ total items × 100%; frequent words are taken in descending order of frequency, top N; handling priority is sorted by share × severity weight, for customer service review and process improvement.
map.投诉归类：粘贴多条投诉文本，工具按预设关键词（物流/质量/服务/价格/售后）逐行: Complaint categorisation: paste several lines of complaint text and the tool matches each line against preset keywords for logistics, quality, service, price and after-sales, automatically categorising them and counting the number and share of each type.
map.改进聚焦：通过「分类覆盖率」指标识别未归类的「其他」投诉，结合高频词（去停用词）: Improvement focus: the classification coverage indicator identifies uncategorised other complaints, and frequent words with stop words removed reveal new pain points, so the keyword library can be iterated.
map.日报生成：输出各类型投诉条数、占比与词频 Top20，直接用于质量例会、供应商或: Daily report generation: output the number and share of each complaint type plus the top 20 word frequencies, ready for quality meetings and supplier or logistics accountability.
map.默认词库：物流(配送/快递/发货/慢/延迟/到货)、质量(质量/坏了/破损/缺陷: Default word library: logistics covers delivery, express, dispatch, slow, delay and arrival; quality covers quality, broken, damaged, defect and faulty; service covers attitude, agent and ignored; price covers expensive, price increase, price and charge; after-sales covers refund, return and repair. Entering 6 lines: the express is too slow and the logistics information is not updated, giving logistics; the product quality has flaws, giving quality; the agent attitude is poor and nobody responds, giving service; the price is too expensive, giving price; the refund process is troublesome and a return is requested, giving after-sales; and feeling down today, giving other. Result: logistics 1, quality 1, service 1, price 1, after-sales 1, other 1, so classification coverage = (6-1)/6 ≈ 83%, meaning 5 of 6 complaints were categorised effectively.
map.分类关键词可以自定义吗？: Can the classification keywords be customised?
map.可以。页面提供关键词输入框，按「类别:词1,词2;类别2:词…」格式填写即可覆盖: Yes. The page provides a keyword input box; fill it in the format category:word1,word2;category2:word… to override the default library, adapting to different business scenarios such as e-commerce, SaaS or physical stores.
map.分类覆盖率低说明什么？: What does a low classification coverage mean?
map.覆盖率 = (总投诉数 − 未归类「其他」数) ÷ 总投诉数。偏低意味着大量投诉: Coverage = (total complaints − the number of uncategorised other items) ÷ total complaints. A low value means many complaints did not hit any keyword, so the library should be extended or frequent other samples distilled into a new category, continuously improving automatic classification.
